extracted.name: Restaurant Style Mac and Cheese
extracted.description: This easy macaroni and cheese is made on the stovetop for a rich, creamy dinnertime favorite.
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.
Return drained pasta to the pot. Mix in processed cheese, Cheddar cheese, and cream. Stir until cheeses melt. Sprinkle with salt.
